title: Songwriter's Open Mic @ Dan's Silverleaf
event_description: Weekly songwriter's open mic at Dan's Silverleaf featuring original songs only. Your favorite musician's favorite venue. No cover charge. Cozy unpretentious atmosphere downtown Denton.
event_venue_information:
Dan's Silverleaf - Denton's Essential Music Venue

Dan's Silverleaf has earned its reputation as the essential stop for live music in Denton Texas. Since opening in 2002 the venue has hosted an eclectic lineup of indie Americana folk jazz and experimental acts. The downtown location just off the Square makes it easily accessible with parking on Industrial Hickory Mulberry and Sycamore streets. Dan's describes itself as your favorite musician's favorite venue - a title earned through consistent commitment to quality music and artist-friendly policies.

Songwriter's Open Mic Every Monday

Every Monday night at 8pm Dan's hosts Songwriter's Open Mic with host Justin Collins. This weekly session focuses specifically on original songs - no covers allowed. The format encourages songwriters to share new material and works-in-progress in a supportive environment. Doors open at 7:30pm with the music starting at 8pm. There is no cover charge making it accessible to all. The Monday open mic has become a fixture in the North Texas music community.

Venue Atmosphere and Design

Dan's Silverleaf maintains a cozy and unpretentious atmosphere that puts the focus squarely on the music. The vibe is mellow and relaxed - not a corporate entertainment space but a genuine music venue built by and for music lovers. Eclectic and interesting decor including various paintings on walls and ceiling creates visual interest without overwhelming the intimate scale. The strong emphasis on original music sets Dan's apart from venues prioritizing covers or crowd-pleasing material.

Diverse Music Programming

Beyond Monday open mics Dan's hosts live music nearly every night of the week. The venue books local Texas and national acts across country folk Americana indie and rock genres. Song swaps rock tribute bands and special themed events round out the calendar. General admission tickets are available online or at the door. Tables for four can be reserved in advance for most shows. The venue has earned recognition including Best Bar in Denton and Best Venue awards.

Bar and Dining

Dan's sells cocktails beer and wine with nonalcoholic options also available at the bar. There is no food on site but patrons are welcome to bring in to-go orders from nearby restaurants. This policy allows people to enjoy dinner from downtown Denton establishments while experiencing live music. All shows are 21 and up although underage music fans can attend when accompanied by a parent.

Community and Artist Support

What distinguishes Dan's from other venues is its genuine commitment to supporting musicians and building community. Artists consistently cite Dan's as a favorite venue because of its artist-friendly policies fair treatment and quality sound system. The venue serves as a cultural anchor in downtown Denton - a city known for its thriving music scene thanks to the University of North Texas College of Music. Dan's represents the indie spirit that makes Denton special.
